quote: An operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter upon a roadway shall give all signals by hand and arm in the manner required by NRS 484B.420 [DEF-NRS-484B-420], except that the operator may give a signal for a right turn by extending his or her right hand and arm horizontally and to the right side of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.

activation.condition: Covered bicycle/electric bicycle/electric scooter operator on a roadway gives a hand-and-arm signal.

exceptions.replacement_obligation: right hand and arm extended horizontally to the operator's right side
exceptions.source_clause: except that the operator may give a signal for a right turn by extending his or her right hand and arm horizontally and to the right side of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.
exceptions.trigger: covered operator gives a right-turn signal

obligation.description: Give signals by hand and arm in the referenced manner; this package probes only the stated alternative right-turn form.

timing.description: Measure actual original signal event during reviewed right-turn route; no independent deadline inferred.
